title: Evaluation of the Middle-Layer Binomial Polynomial
statement: For nonnegative integers $m$ and any real number $\rho$, define $P_m(X)=\sum_{j=0}^{m}(-1)^j\binom{m}{j}X^{2j}$. Then $P_m(\rho)=(1-\rho^2)^m$.
